name: J850 Core
summary: Multi-material PolyJet system in the J850 family.

page.description: Stratasys J850 Core 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.

page.lead: The J850 build tray and 14-micron detail, with up to three materials per print (rigid, flexible, transparent and tough), for teams that don’t need full colour.
page.footnote: Source: stratasys.com J850 Core page, read 10 Nov 2026.
